name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
summary: At Freewind Post, a Horde bounty calls for Arnak Grimtotem’s death. The authorities seek the violent Grimtotem exile for murder and kidnapping on the mesas above the canyon.

sections.title: A Gruesome Crime
sections.body: Tauren of the Horde and the reclusive Grimtotem have long been at odds. Arnak worsened that strife by murdering a tauren and abducting the victim’s sister, Lakota Windsong. Branded an outcast, he drew the notice of Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post. Longhorn sanctioned an open bounty calling for Arnak’s death.

sections.title: Darkcloud Pinnacle
sections.body: Arnak has taken refuge on the high northern cliff mesas of Darkcloud Pinnacle. Grimtotem encampments spread across the high crags near the entrance to Razorfen Downs, linked by rope bridges. Lakota Windsong is held captive there and waits for rescue. Anyone who reaches her must cross the Grimtotem bridges.

faq.answer: Arnak Grimtotem is a tauren outcast who murdered a tauren and kidnapped Lakota Windsong. His crimes led Freewind Post to put a bounty on his head.

faq.q: Where can Arnak Grimtotem be found?
faq.answer: Arnak is high on the northern cliff mesas of Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. Reach the winding path south of the Great Lift, then cross the high wooden bridges toward Razorfen Downs.
Lakota Windsong is a tauren captive held by Arnak on Darkcloud Pinnacle. Arnak murdered her brother during her abduction, and she remains stranded on the mesa until he is dealt with.
Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post manages the bounty. He rewards travelers who bring Arnak’s severed hoof as proof that the rogue tauren has been brought to justice.

faq.q: Is Arnak officially working for the Grimtotem tribe?
faq.answer: The bounty calls Arnak an outcast, showing he acted beyond tribal law. He has taken refuge within the Grimtotem stronghold of Darkcloud Pinnacle.

faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?
aliases: what do i bring cliffwatcher longhorn
faq.answer: Hunters must sever and return Arnak’s Hoof to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to verify his death and receive the bounty.

angles.text: As a tauren loyal to Cairne Bloodhoof, you can see tracking down Arnak as tribal justice. He is a kinslayer who dishonored tauren traditions by abducting Lakota Windsong.
Freewind Post is the Horde’s lifeline through Thousand Needles. By eliminating renegades on Darkcloud Pinnacle, you secure the heights along the canyon floor.
